name: Get Rich Quick Schemes
overview: Scripture warns against the folly of seeking wealth through quick and dishonest means, emphasizing instead the value of diligent labor and wise planning. Proverbs teaches that wealth gained hastily or by oppressing others is fleeting and leads to want, while steady work and thoughtful preparation bring lasting provision. The slothful and those who chase after vanity are contrasted with the wise who heed instruction and build their lives on solid effort, highlighting that true prosperity comes from patience and integrity rather than shortcuts.
